prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational / precise-object-edit.
EDIT IMAGE 1 in place. IMAGE 1 is an existing approved Kansei anatomy painting; preserve its exact dimensions and register all anatomical geometry. IMAGE 2 is the real ultrasound for INTERNAL ECHOTEXTURE reference, IMAGE 3 is the clinician's original annotated boundary guide. This is a local material correction, NOT a new anatomy composition.

Only change the deep gray CAPSULE/ANTERIOR JOINT RECESS region between iliopsoas and the bone surface. Preserve EVERY muscle belly, branching ivory fascia, gold fat, all bone trabeculae, the ivory cortical edge and its real irregularities, placement, scale, canvas, and style outside this region. Do not shift, smooth, sharpen, deepen or invent any bony notch. No new bone, no cartilage ribbon, no labrum, no needle, no extra structures.

CORRECTION: Image1 incorrectly paints the whole capsular/recess region as solid dense fibrous collagen, a closed cocoon. This is a LONGITUDINAL CUT through a distended anterior hip recess: a fibrous capsular BOUNDARY/SURFACE and a separate INTERNAL CONTENT are visible in section. Keep only a thin, gently layered ivory/gray capsular wall along the superior boundary immediately deep to muscle, following the existing contour. Make the interior distinct from that wall. Replace the broad long rope-like white collagen throughout the recess with a soft muted slate-gray/taupe, finely granular and softly mottled, heterogeneous internal material with low contrast subtle gray internal echoes following the real ultrasound. This is illustrative echo-bearing contents, not a histological diagnosis.

The interior must remain genuinely GRAY rather than an empty pitch-black/navy fluid hole. It should look like an open longitudinally sectioned joint recess, not a cyst/bursa/closed cocoon with a thick wall encircling everything. No continuous thick ivory rind at the sides or at the bone surface. Keep the source ivory bone cortex as the deep boundary. Where a deep lining is suggested, it is extremely fine and subdued, not a second tendon band. No red synovitis, no Doppler vessels, no inflammatory glow, no nodules or floating particles, no pus, no arbitrary black pockets or septa, no extra lesion. The heterogeneity must be restrained and continuous, mostly soft gray cloudy/granular substance, not long fibrous/tendinous bundles. Keep the same detailed matte medical-painting finish, with surrounding muscle and fascia unchanged. No labels, arrows, legend, watermarks, outline colors or text. Output only the single edited painting.
Image1 is a square scan-field crop of Image2's rectangle x226..1053,y111..891 on1280x960. In Image1 the correction region is the broad gray area beginning around 45% canvas height at left, 49% centrally and 57% at right, down to the unchanged low bone surface. Keep the large distension. Thin upper wall follows the existing gray/red interface. The large interior should reproduce the source's cloudy gray internal echoes, somewhat darker centrally/deeply, with very fine scattered gray texture. Preserve the tiny unclassified dark round aperture near the right upper margin at ~86%width,55%height and its immediate surrounding connective tissue; it is not the target or a new diagnosis. The bone drops steeply at left into a low shallow valley; keep it exact, do not make a round ball.
revision: Long-axis capsule surface and gray heterogeneous recess contents; preserve other anatomy. No diagnosis inferred from echogenicity.
